rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) names the item. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow printed order). Schedule 1 rows map by ATC block, the printed effective-date caption and the Export/Taxable/Due column headers. The second group of Php 50.60 blocks on page 3 is left out. Page-2/3 header repeats of tinA/branchCode/registeredName are left out because each writer key can be joined once. Address line 2, Part IV date combs and tax agent cells stay blank because the layout has no key for them. Items 8-9 share one 40-slot comb, and each of items 10 and 11 has one 40-slot comb for its region, province and city codes; each comb takes one derived print-map line (to_print_field_map) with the values placed under their own captions. The three Others rows join ATC, description, tax bracket and rate by the column captions of the Schedule 1 header. Since #113: the page 2/3 header comb, the item 7 second line and the page 3 XA056 block (keys matched by the ATC, effective date and rate the model gives each key) print too; every other value has a reviewed not_joined reason. One writer key may fill several cells (html_ids).
